_comment: Qi-lab Hi-TOM protocol constants. These are fixed by the HiTOM library design and do not change between runs. Source: Qi-lab standard operating procedure.

tail_bridges._comment: Sequences clipped from the 3-prime end of reads when the amplicon is short enough that the read runs through to the other bridge. r1_tail_bridge = RC(reverse_bridge); r2_tail_bridge = RC(forward_bridge).

forward_barcodes._comment: Standard Qi-lab Hi-TOM 12-plex forward barcodes (F1-F12). Sequences are 4 bp.

reverse_barcodes._comment: Standard Qi-lab Hi-TOM 8-plex reverse barcodes (R-A through R-H). Sequences are 4 bp.

defaults._comment: Default barcode extraction and trimming positions. Based on the Hi-TOM primer structure: 4 random bases + 4 bp barcode at positions 4:8. The 27-bp leader (4 random + 4 barcode + ~19 bp bridge/primer) is trimmed from both R1 and R2.
